issues.description: The Bitmap24::save method has conflicting return types between template and solution: the template declares it returns int, while the solution defines it as void. This can confuse students and can cause compilation/link errors if they follow one signature while the build expects the other.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the signature across template and solution. Prefer changing the template to match the solution: declare `void save(const std::string &i_filename);` in Bitmap24.hpp (template) and ensure the .cpp definition matches. Alternatively, keep `int save(...)` everywhere and return a status code consistently.

issues.description: Inconsistent use of the preprocessor macro name to disable the standalone `main` functions in NASM files: the assembly sources use `%ifndef era` / `-Dera=1`, while the tests Makefile uses `-dera=1` (different macro identifier). This breaks the intended conceptual mapping of a single "ERA build mode" flag across artifacts and can lead to students believing they are enabling the same flag while actually not (depending on NASM option parsing), causing duplicate `main` symbol/link issues.
issues.suggestedFix: Standardize the macro identifier and its definition across build scripts: use `-Dera=1` consistently (including in `tests/Makefile`) to match `%ifndef era` in the assembly files, or rename the assembly guards to match the actual macro used.
